channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Ronald Kiandee suspended from Bersatu
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Bersatu vice-president Datuk Seri Dr Ronald Kiandee has been suspended from the party for two election terms, effective immediately.

item.title: Iga Swiatek, feeling at home in Indian Wells, back in round of 16
item.description: INDIAN WELLS: Iga Swiatek and Greece’s Maria Sakkari met in the final of the BNP Paribas Open at Indian Wells, Calif., in 2022 and 2024, and each time, the Polish star won in straight sets.

item.title: Siniakova ends Andreeva Indian Wells defense in third round
item.description: INDIAN WELLS: Unseeded Katerina Siniakova ended Mirra Andreeva’s Indian Wells title defense on Monday, rallying for a 4-6, 7-6 (7/5) 6-3 victory over the eighth-ranked Russian.

item.title: Penang Port ramps up monitoring as Middle East tensions disrupt shipping
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: Penang Port Commission (PPC) has stepped up monitoring of port operations and cargo movements after Middle East tensions, warning of shipping delays, congestion and rising costs.

item.title: Penang industries may face supply chain disruptions if Middle East conflict drags on
item.description: GEORGE TOWN: The ongoing conflict in the Middle East could potentially affect Penang’s industrial sector, particularly through supply chain disruptions, logistics challenges, and rising energy costs if the crisis continues.

item.title: Denmark and Greenland play it cool to chill Trump
item.description: COPENHAGEN: After weathering Donald Trump’s repeated threats to take control of Greenland, Copenhagen and Nuuk want to restore a bit of calm ahead of the Danish general election this month, observers say.

item.title: Embassy moves stranded Malaysians from Qatar
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian embassy in Doha facilitated the transport of Malaysians stranded in Qatar to Jeddah by bus as part of the evacuation on Monday.

item.title: Viral dashcam clip lands two drivers in trouble for dangerous overtaking [WATCH]
item.description: KOTA TINGGI: Two motorists who were caught on dashcam executing a dangerous overtake along the Senai–Desaru Expressway were hauled up by police yesterday.

item.title: US investigators search Epstein's former New Mexico ranch
item.description: WASHINGTON: Investigators in New Mexico began searching on Monday the former ranch of convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, as part of a probe into allegations women and girls were abused there, authorities said.

item.title: Crocodile sighting at Tanjung Aru prompts safety operations in KK
item.description: KOTA KINABALU: Authorities have been conducting operations to ensure the safety of beachgoers following a recent crocodile sighting.
